SELECT name, code, spell FROM station
AND query_type = #{queryType} AND ( `name` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR spell LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

SELECT tss.sequence AS sequence, tss.arrival_time AS arrivalTime, tss.departure_time AS departure_time, s.name AS stationName FROM train_stop_station tss INNER JOIN station s ON tss.station_id = s.id WHERE tss.train_id = #{trainId}
SELECT ttd.id AS typeId, ttd.type_name AS typeName, ttd.type_code AS typeCode FROM train_train_type ttt INNER JOIN train_type_dict ttd ON ttt.type_id = ttd.id WHERE ttt.train_id = #{trainId}
